rules: Material or evolution-relevant detected problems preserve durable causal evidence here or in a linked record.
Small local defects may use compact records; do not promote every incident into a permanent domain rule.
Domain-only learning remains A-share owned. Common/cross-domain failure classes are upcalled to UAOS with structured evidence.
Failed or rejected repair paths that materially informed the decision are preserved rather than silently rewritten out of history.
Repair/no-change requires owner-native root-scope evidence and evolution disposition; parent guidance may be used to resolve unknown root scope without fabricating a diagnosis.
